terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: The IMAGEN sheet is visual form evidence. The archived v1 runtime contract is authoritative for bounds, pivots, sockets, colliders and animation state.

objectClass.primaryType: faceted countertop blender with transparent vessel
objectClass.notes: The v1 runtime contract freezes the 144-node rig. The IMAGEN sheet only reallocates visual masses within that envelope.

reasoning: Transparent jar ordering must coexist with opaque fruit, blades, liquid and splash volumes.
Jar, lid, blade, dial, fruit and liquid pivots are all independently animated and must reset exactly.
Eight ribs, four blades, five vents, four feet and twelve fruit chunks are repeated systems.
The current runtime exposes 144 named objects and ten semantic sockets whose local transforms are frozen.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The redesign changes visual geometry only and must preserve the existing high-density performance rig.

details.description: Low 8-sided mint lid knob with a crisp stepped upper rim.
Broad Sakura-pink lid uses a stepped 12-sided umbrella crown.
Thin projecting lid flange overlaps the jar rim.
Translucent pink collar continues below the lid.
Transparent jar widens upward as a readable 12-sided faceted vessel.
Eight sparse molded ribs follow the faceted jar taper without milky overlap.
Bold cream 8-sided three-bend handle forms a tall angular opening with thick embedded roots.
Four enlarged dark metal blade wedges cant upward around a faceted hub.
Shallow pink jar seat separates vessel from motor base.
Warm cream upper motor shoulder is compressed into a stronger trapezoid transition.
Sakura-pink lower enclosure reads as a chunky faceted plinth inside the v1 footprint.
Straight horizontal cream-to-pink enclosure seam.
Oversized layered mint speed dial is approximately 18 percent larger while retaining the frozen pivot.
Narrow vertical marker is recessed into the dial face.
Small circular status lens sits above the speed dial.
Five horizontal rounded vent slots occupy the rear cream panel.
Dark two-pin inlet is centered low on the rear pink panel.
Four shallow dark rubber feet support the base.
Jar edges and ribs carry brighter low-roughness highlights than the center.
Powered-only smoothie vortex and ingredient spiral communicate blending.
Stable dark-plum outline hierarchy uses main, structure and detail widths with object-space plus/minus 18 percent variation.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: The base, jar, lid, handle, fruit and control read as the same blender from all four reference views while preserving the exact v1 full-tree bounds.
The jar, lid, handle, dial, blade, fruit, liquid and splash geometry remain children of the frozen v1 pivots and sockets.
The model uses broad 6-12 sided facets, stepped bevels and a 0.0048/0.0041/0.0033 stable outline hierarchy without temporal jitter.
Startup, chop, blend, two lid bounces, mouth splash, wind-down and stop all retain one animation owner and exact reset.

buildPasses.goal: Lock the total silhouette and macro proportions.
acceptance: Front, side and back macro silhouette agrees with the turn sheet.
Handle opening and jar flare remain recognizable.
Browser comparison score is at least 0.7.
The v1 Box3 and ground height remain exact after the low-poly silhouette change.

buildPasses.goal: Build independent vessel, lid, blade, control, rear-service and foot assemblies.
acceptance: Named pivots and sockets exist for blade, dial, lid, handle and power.
Four blades, eight ribs, five vents and four feet remain independent readable systems.
No visible floating attachments.

buildPasses.goal: Refine jar wall thickness, handle roots, lid crown, base taper, seams, ribs and rear recesses.
acceptance: Curves, bevels and negative spaces remain legible across four browser views.
Three-quarter render proves non-planar depth.
Jar, handle, lid and base use broad readable facets instead of smooth hose or toy forms.

buildPasses.goal: Separate cream, pink, mint, transparent jar, steel, cavity and rubber responses.
acceptance: Transparent jar reveals blades without reading as an opaque white cup.
Cream, pink, mint, steel and dark recess materials remain distinct.
Stylized source PBR limitation is documented.
Opaque shells use the v2 outline hierarchy while transparent jar, liquid and micro details avoid black clumping.

buildPasses.goal: Verify bevels, transparent edges, blade depth and contact shadows.
acceptance: Key, fill and rim reveal jar edges and pastel zoning without highlight blowout.
Neutral, grazing and reference-matched checks remain readable.

buildPasses.goal: Show an unmistakable blender cycle and exact reset.
acceptance: Dial turns, indicator lights, four blades spin and ingredients visibly spiral into a smoothie vortex.
Powered cue completes within 5.2 seconds.
stop restores all transforms, visibility, opacity and emissive state exactly.
Both splash emitters remain aligned with their frozen cup-mouth sockets through lid motion.

buildPasses.goal: Preserve browser real-time performance after fidelity acceptance.
acceptance: Peak triangles do not exceed 1.35 times the v1 browser peak of 29082.
Peak draw calls do not exceed 1.20 times the v1 browser peak of 92.
Repeated low-poly geometry is shared where stable node identity permits.
Three rebuild and disposal cycles leave no geometry or material undisposed.

featureReviews.notes: Two-band base, flared jar, stepped lid and right-side handle remain immediately recognizable; exact v1 Box3 is preserved within 1e-4.

visualEvidence.notes: Transparent jar remains readable without an opaque outline fill; fruit, blade and handle attachment remain visible.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The current model retains the generated concept's faceted base, lid, jar flare and dial hierarchy while honoring the stricter v1 runtime envelope. Material and lighting differences are deferred to their locked passes.

featureReviews.notes: The transparent twelve-sided vessel, collar, eight separate vertical ribs and both angular handle roots read as one attached assembly in front, side, back and three-quarter views.
The pink seat, dark coupling, raised hub and four independently named canted blades remain visible through the clear jar without floating gaps.
The enlarged mint dial, stepped pink ring, marker and inset status point are strongly legible while the frozen dial pivot is unchanged.
The corrected strict back view now shows five separate vent slots, a framed power inlet and the grounded foot system on the shell surface.

visualEvidence.notes: Generated concept is chunkier; procedural result preserves the same hierarchy and all frozen rig anchors.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: Four-view review confirms the characteristic stepped base, transparent vessel, blades and enlarged dial. Rear-service correction raises back-view readability without changing cable socket coordinates.

featureReviews.notes: The two-stage tapered base, flared vessel, wide lid and open handle preserve the v1 silhouette while reading more boldly in all four views.
Twelve-sided jar planes, thick collar, separate ribs and eight-sided swept handle create clear low-poly depth and an unobstructed negative-space opening.
The oversized multi-ring dial projects from the tapered base as a deliberate gameplay control rather than a flat decal.
Five vents and the inlet remain separated from the rear shell with sufficient relief and no envelope expansion.

visualEvidence.notes: The runtime model is intentionally cleaner and more spacious than the concept while retaining its exaggerated low-poly hierarchy.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: Three-quarter and axial views show true depth in the dial, jar taper, lid tiers, handle roots and rear service relief; no hose-like smoothing remains.

featureReviews.notes: The jar remains clearly transparent, exposes blades and fruit, and uses pale facet highlights and separate ribs instead of an opaque black-rimmed cup.
Cream shoulder, pink base, mint dial, deep-plum marker and indicator remain distinct at gameplay scale.
Outer shells use the heaviest stable ink, structural rings and handle seams use a middle tier, and tiny marks use the fine tier; clear jar, liquid and particle systems are excluded from clumping.

visualEvidence.notes: Material intent matches the generated concept through procedural color and Toon values rather than unavailable PBR texture evidence.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The reference/render pair shows clear category separation and an unobstructed jar interior. Dark edges remain concentrated on opaque silhouette and structural seams.

featureReviews.notes: Warm key, cool-purple fill and pink grazing rim preserve the stable unequal ink tiers, reveal jar edges and broad base facets, and avoid highlight blowout.
